per_question.question: Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic services under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B?
per_question.agent_answer:
No. **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B does not cover chiropractic services as such**; it covers **orthotics and prosthetics** when the beneficiary meets the policy’s coverage criteria. The policy’s covered-service rules are limited to orthotic and prosthetic devices, and the ordering/providers it names are physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and certain certified orthotics/prosthetics providers—not chiropractic services. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

## Why
Under Policy 5B, a service/product is covered only if it meets the general coverage criteria, including that it is individualized, medically necessary, and not more than the beneficiary needs. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

More specifically, Policy 5B says orthotics and prosthetics are covered when they are:
- ordered by a **physician, physician assistant, or nurse practitioner**;
- medically necessary to maintain or improve the beneficiary’s medical, physical, or functional level; and
- supported by the required face-to-face encounter and annual review. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

The policy also explains that orthotic devices are covered when needed to correct/prevent skeletal deformities, support or align movable body parts, or preserve/improve physical function, and prosthetic devices are covered as replacements for permanently inoperative, absent, or malfunctioning body parts. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

## Bottom line
If by “chiropractic services” you mean **spinal manipulation or treatment by a chiropractor**, I could **not verify any coverage for that service under Policy 5B**. Policy 5B is a device-coverage policy for orthotics and prosthetics, not a chiropractic-services policy. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

I also checked for amendments tied to Policy 5B and did **not** find any listed change notice amending the current document in the corpus.
